children: Shares of CoreWeave climb after-hours as the company reports third-quarter revenue ahead of analyst expectations and lifts its full-year revenue outlook. The company now expects to generate between $13 billion and $13.3 billion in revenue this year, compared with analyst expectations of $12.82 billion. CoreWeave also expects to exit the year with $20 billion to $21 billion in annualized run-rate revenue. The market's reaction is a relief for CoreWeave, whose stock has been hammered in recent weeks due to investor worries about the AI infrastructure buildout. Shares gain 6.4% to $51.85 after-hours. (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
